summary: The MaintCourseDetailsCompetency file contains code related to managing course competencies within a web application. It includes user interface elements such as a grid view and pop-up panels for displaying and editing competencies.
purpose: To facilitate the management and editing of course competencies within the web application.

workflows.name: Competency Management
steps: Display competency list in grid view.

business_rules: Data binding for the competencies is dependent on a valid user session and course ID.
validations: Ensure user session is available before data operations.
Hide the 'Edit All' button if the screen is not editable.
calculations: Update competencies based on user input and save to the database.
conditions: ScreenIsEditable determines visibility of editing options.
system_behavior: Uses QueryString for passing parameters between pages.
exceptions: Cancel data operations if user session is null.
